plain: A date, time or datetime-local Input shows the HDS calendar or clock icon at its trailing edge instead of the browser's glyph.

steps.plain: A date, time or datetime-local Input renders an aria-hidden icon span after the field; a test that counts the field's children or snapshots its DOM needs updating.
focus-visible:ring-2 now draws only the HDS focus outline, not Tailwind's box-shadow ring under it; add your own ring if you relied on both.
